result:
I found two blocking problems and two advisory ones. The worst: a tampered release bundle can pass verification and run its own code as root during deploy.

```
VERDICT: FINDINGS
CANDIDATE: 31b63b522f26ed3ac1204ea954dba25e2a8bbc67
FINDING bundle-self-attested blocking: Release verification only checks the bundle against its own RELEASE.json, which is unsigned and can be rewritten. Nothing outside the bundle anchors it unless --sha256 is given, and deploy_release.sh treats --sha256 as optional. So anyone who can swap the bundle can change any file, recompute RELEASE.json, and have deploy_release.sh run their copy of scripts/up.sh, deploy_custom.sh and check_access.py as root. | evidence: scripts/release.py:146 checks the digest only `if expected_sha256 is not None`, and lines 186-201 check the manifest only against the bundle's own contents. scripts/deploy_release.sh:186,197,211 sets sha=() by default and calls verify_bundle "$bundle" with no digest. In scratch, poc/crm-release-31b63b522f26.tar.gz had scripts/up.sh replaced with attacker code and RELEASE.json recomputed. `release.py verify` printed "bundle verified: commit 31b63b52… (5 files)", rc=0. Docs (README.md, BETA.md:78, RELEASE.md:37) always show --sha256, but the code does not enforce it. | expected: Make --sha256 mandatory in deploy_release.sh, with a die before step 1 when it is missing, or anchor verification to something outside the bundle. Add a unit test where a bundle with a consistently re-hashed RELEASE.json is refused without the external digest.
FINDING beta-db-dir-unchecked blocking: CRM_DB_DIR, the crm-db bind source at /var/lib/mysql, is the only bind mount not checked for beta. A beta env file with CRM_DB_DIR=/srv/CRM/runtime/dev/db passes every guard, so crm-beta's MariaDB would open crm-dev's data directory. That gives beta access to dev data, and two servers writing one datadir can corrupt it. This is the "beta path can reach crm-dev resources" condition, and it contradicts the env.example/BETA.md:70 claim that the dirs are "exactly /srv/CRM/runtime/beta/{db,…}". | evidence: scripts/lib/common.sh:146-170 (require_runtime_paths) loops only over CRM_DATA_DIR CRM_CUSTOM_DIR CRM_CLIENT_CUSTOM_DIR. CRM_MOUNT_CHECK (common.sh:180-205) checks only crm-app and crm-daemon. check_access.py validate_beta / check_beta_compose never read CRM_DB_DIR. deploy/beta/compose.json:16 takes the source straight from ${CRM_DB_DIR}. grep shows no test asserting a beta db path. The same gap existed for dev before this change, but beta is new exposure. | expected: Add CRM_DB_DIR→$CRM_RUNTIME_DIR/db to require_runtime_paths and the crm-db mount to require_compose_mounts, for both targets. Add a unit test that refuses CRM_DB_DIR pointing at the dev runtime.
FINDING upgrade-skips-reverify advisory: With --upgrade, if /srv/CRM/deploy/<short> already exists, unpack_release skips unpacking. The deploy then runs the scripts already in that directory without comparing them to the bundle that was just verified, so a stale or modified tree is run as root. Changing it needs root, so the risk is limited. | evidence: scripts/deploy_release.sh:58-60, then render_edge/start_stack use "$dest/scripts/..." (lines 94,101-102). | expected: On upgrade, check the existing tree's file hashes against the verified RELEASE.json, or refuse and re-unpack.
FINDING restoretest-dir-scope advisory: The CRM_RESTORETEST_DIR override only has to be named beta-restoretest, sit under a canonical parent and not overlap the beta runtime. It may still sit inside the crm-dev runtime, for example /srv/CRM/runtime/dev/beta-restoretest, where restored beta customer data would be written. It must not exist beforehand, so rm -rf deletes only what the test created. | evidence: scripts/lib/restoretest.sh:46-61 has no check against /srv/CRM/runtime/dev. | expected: Require the parent to be exactly /srv/CRM/runtime (or refuse any path under the dev runtime), with the test override confined to a tmp root.
EVIDENCE:
- git -C worktree rev-parse HEAD = 31b63b522f26ed3ac1204ea954dba25e2a8bbc67 (matches the candidate). Working tree is clean before and after review.
- gitleaks git --log-opts=e1f9a689..31b63b52 --redact: 1 commit scanned, "no leaks found".
- Scanned the diff for IPs and hosts: only 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0 in refusal fixtures, the RFC 5737 documentation ranges 192.0.2.x and 198.51.100.7, and *.example. No real IP, hostname or person/firm name found.
- Allowlist: every changed path is in scope, and the README change is only in the usage section. No iptables, ufw or nft in added lines.
- Register: haproxy digest sha256:1c3568e5…e597c is identical in EXTERNAL_CODE_REGISTER.yaml, deploy/beta/compose.json:129 and the work order. It is pinned with no tag, as the PL decided.
- Edge template and policy are acceptable:
  - one bind on a validated RFC 1918 unicast IP and port 1024-65535 (0.0.0.0, `*` and `::` are refused);
  - `acl src` takes 1-4 private /32s;
  - X-Forwarded-For is deleted, then a 403 deny comes first for untrusted sources;
  - X-Forwarded-Proto is set only `if trusted_upstream`;
  - forwardfor goes to exactly one 127.0.0.1 server;
  - no tcp-request rules or http-request allow.
  The edge service is host-network, read_only, cap_drop ALL with no cap_add, no-new-privileges, user haproxy. crm-app publishes only on 127.0.0.1, and no other service publishes a port (check_beta_compose).
- Secrets: run_clean / compose / rt_compose unset every env-file name before calling docker. The restoretest root password is generated into a 0600 file and read inside the container through MYSQL_PWD, never put in argv. The beta-safe API key is read from a 0600 non-symlink file. The deploy report includes only commit, images, records and status.
- Restoretest: project, compose file and runtime directory are constants. The compose has one crm-db, no ports or binds, a project-scoped volume and an internal network. Teardown is `down -v` for crm-beta-restoretest only, plus rm -rf of a directory whose name has been checked.
- Timer units: oneshot root with UMask=0077 and hardening. They are not installed by any script.
- Beta-safe suite: ReadOnlyClient sends GET only. Seeding refuses any CRM_TARGET other than dev, and any URL that isn't http on port 8180 (check_access rejects 8180 for beta).
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/unit: Ran 376 tests, OK.
- PoC: scratch/scripts_poc/tamper.py built a forged crm-release-31b63b522f26.tar.gz (modified up.sh, recomputed RELEASE.json). release.py verify accepted it with rc=0.
```
